move: three layered gradient waves sweep sideways and heave up and down
how: Three SVG paths, each a cubic-approximated sine wave three wavelengths wide with a vertical blue gradient (deep blue back, mid blue, pale cyan front), are stacked with baselines at 300, 420 and 540px. Each path translates x by an integer number of wavelengths over D with ease none (back layers 1-2 cycles leftward, front layer 3 cycles rightward) so the seam is invisible. Each also heaves y up 30-54px and back with sine.inOut yoyo, one cycle for the back layer and up to three for the front. The stage is a navy vertical gradient.
adapt: Change the three gradient pairs and the background, the amplitudes and baselines, and the number of layers. Keep the integer-wavelength travel per D and integer heave cycles so the loop stays seamless.
port: mount(el, shot) injects the SVG with gradient defs and generates the wave paths from the layer table; animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline of x sweeps over D and y yoyos, selecting paths within el. Path geometry assumes a 1280x720 viewBox with preserveAspectRatio none, so it stretches to any shot size.
